<!-- What the change does and why. The rules are in
     docs/internals/contributing.md; the checklist is the short form. -->

- [ ] A test exercises the change, and it failed against the code before it.
- [ ] Anything EmbCC still cannot do is refused by name, not compiled into something else.
- [ ] The manual says what the compiler now does (and no other page still says the old thing).
- [ ] Commit subjects have the form `area: summary`.
